implemented_requirements.requirement: Define Card class and deck utilities
implemented_requirements.evidence: card.py defines Card, rank order, suit list, and basic string representation.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Three‑player game loop with landlord role
implemented_requirements.evidence: No game loop, player classes, or landlord selection logic present in the provided files.
No code related to bidding, bids, or landlord assignment.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validation of all Dou Dizhu combinations (single, pair, triple, straight, bomb, etc.)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a stub Enum ComboType with a single entry; no validation functions or combination logic.
No implementation of turn order, pass handling, or comparison of combination strengths.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Win condition detection (first to empty hand or prevent landlord win)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code that tracks player hands, detects empty hand, or declares a winner.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Executable entry point (e.g., main function or script)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No main guard or runnable script is provided.

critical_issues: Missing core game engine (player management, turn sequencing, hand distribution).
No bidding implementation to select the landlord.
Combination validation and ranking logic are absent.
Pass‑or‑beat mechanics and win‑condition checks are not present.
ui.py is incomplete; only a placeholder Enum is defined.
No executable entry point; the repository cannot be run as a program.
judge.summary: The repository only contains a basic Card class and a skeletal UI enum. All essential features required for a functional Dou Dizhu game—three‑player management, landlord bidding, valid combination handling, pass/beat logic, and win detection—are missing. Consequently, the implementation is far from complete and unlikely to be executable in its current state.
